message.content: I'd like an architecture diagram of our platform for the client's architecture review board next Thursday. I'm at my desk all day, so ask me whatever you need.

content.text:
Happy to. A review board will take whatever is drawn as a claim about your system, so I will ask one thing at a time, each with the answer I would pick, and stop as soon as what is left could not change the drawing.

**What should the diagram cover?**

My recommendation: one end-to-end flow, the one the board is most likely to probe, rather than the whole platform. A whole-platform view at review-board detail usually runs to forty boxes and answers no one question well.
